mcp.addFile.message: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}. Every project can turn it on in its MCP tab; it runs only where it is on. It runs:
mcp.addFile.replaceDetail: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one, on only where you chose: projects that had the old one on lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.allProjects.confirmMessage: New sessions in every project start it, except in projects that turned it off in their MCP tab. To use it in one project only, turn it on in that project's MCP tab instead. It runs:
mcp.error.fileChanged: {file} has changed since it was shown to you. Add it again to see what it runs.
mcp.error.noServer: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.import.changed: {count, plural, one {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw it, so it was copied turned off: check what it runs and turn it on in the MCP tab.} other {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw them, so they were copied turned off: check what they run and turn them on in the MCP tab.}}
mcp.import.confirmMessage: {count, plural, one {It is turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn it on in their MCP tab. It runs:} other {They are turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn them on in their MCP tab. They run:}}
mcp.import.confirmTitle: {count, plural, one {Copy {name} to the workspace?} other {Copy # MCP servers to the workspace?}}
mcp.list.allOffTip: Click to turn it on for all projects (new sessions). To use it in one project, turn it on in that project's MCP tab.
mcp.list.allOnTip: On for all projects (new sessions), except projects that turned it off. Click to turn it off for all projects: projects that turned it on themselves keep it.
mcp.project.confirmMessage: New sessions in {project} start it. It runs:
mcp.tab.hint: Every MCP server in the workspace is available here: turn on the ones this project's agents need. A server on for all projects is on here unless you turn it off.
mcp.tab.projectDefined: These servers are in the project's own agent config (such as .mcp.json). Hive starts sessions with only workspace servers, so they stay disabled until copied to the workspace, which turns them on here.
